data.gender_notes: Godfrey is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Godfrey is derived from the Germanic words 'God' and 'Frey'. The former refers to the Christian God, while the latter signifies a 'free man'. The name thus embodies the concept of a man being free under God's protection and guidance. The name Godfrey carries the meaning “God's free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Godfrey usually hope their child will grow to embody god's free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of faith and freedom.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Godfrey total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_latin.name: Godfrey
